questions.q: True or false? Your team has two defenders, three midfielders, one forward.
questions.explain: Yes. Two at the back, three in the middle and one ahead, plus the keeper.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Two at the back, three in the middle and one ahead, plus the keeper.
Count again. Two defenders, three midfielders and one forward start ahead of the keeper.

questions.q: The ball goes across the team. Put the steps in order.
options: Left defender passes inside to you
Ball goes to the right defender
questions.explain: Right. You help, pass back, the ball switches, then you move across.
choiceExplanations: Right. You help, pass back, the ball switches, then you move across.
You give it back only after the left defender passes to you.
The right defender gets the ball after you pass it back.
You move across once the ball reaches the right defender.

questions.q: The left midfielder has the ball. Where can the middle midfielder help?
questions.explain: Yes. Close and inside gives the passer another angle.
